name: 70127 · New Orleans, LA
findings: ZIP 70127 (New Orleans) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70127 (New Orleans) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70127 (New Orleans) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
